motivation.timing: specified before any R5-v5 transform generation or decoder exposure
motivation.interpretation: R5-v5 is an explicitly labelled follow-up; it does not change or replace the frozen R5-v4 endpoint
motivation.outcome_independence: all three transforms run in frozen order regardless of all R5-v5 decoder results

transform_contract.output_format: little-endian interleaved signed-int16 I,Q with identical byte length

block-fft-random-phase.operation: independent uniform FFT-bin phases per block with original bin magnitudes
block-fft-random-phase.preservation: local block FFT magnitude and Parseval power before one deterministic anti-clipping gain and CI16 rounding
block-fft-random-phase.telemetry_destruction_target: ordered time-domain symbol structure encoded by cross-bin phase

circular-q-delay.operation: global positive circular delay of Q relative to unchanged I
circular-q-delay.preservation: exact ordered I values and exact Q marginal multiset in CI16
circular-q-delay.telemetry_destruction_target: simultaneous I/Q trajectory while retaining realistic component marginals

block-phase-increment-permutation.operation: PCG64 permutation of wrapped adjacent phase increments within each block, retaining first phase
block-phase-increment-permutation.preservation: sample-index amplitude-envelope shape and exact within-block increment multiset before deterministic anti-clipping gain and CI16 rounding
block-phase-increment-permutation.telemetry_destruction_target: ordered differential-phase trajectory while retaining envelope and increment distribution

execution_policy.permitted_early_stop: operational integrity failure only; resume must complete the frozen schedule

post_81_null_validity.timing: evaluated independently only after all 81 frozen pairs complete
post_81_null_validity.exclusion_granularity: entire transform across both receivers; never individual result-selected pairs

circular-q-delay.reason: an I-only decoder can retain telemetry because I is byte-exact

post_81_null_validity.qualified_combined_far_rule: combine only whole transforms eligible in principle and passing every independent destruction threshold
post_81_null_validity.no_optional_stopping: qualification occurs after the complete fixed schedule and never changes which pairs run

attempted_descriptive_dimensions: each transform x both receivers combined
all transforms x both receivers combined
qualified_far_dimensions: each eligible passing whole transform x baseline receiver
each eligible passing whole transform x native receiver
each eligible passing whole transform x both receivers combined
all eligible passing whole transforms x each receiver
all eligible passing whole transforms x both receivers combined
